messages:
noah: noticed oddness in quota-heartbeat metrics at 08:03 UTC — per-tenant remaining tokens briefly jumped then settled. looks like a routing policy flip?
sylvie: saw that too. correlates with a short-lived config rollout that changed quota-hedging from strict->optimistic at 08:01.
metering-bot: quota-heartbeat service reported RECONCILE_START for shard-7 at 08:02:12 by otto.
otto: i rolled a perf patch to hedging to reduce cold-start rejections. it had a fallback path that re-emitted session credits when route fallback occurred.
noah: re-emitted session credits => preview invoices show +ve blips for some tenants who hit fallback paths. billing flagged a few low-volume tenants.
billing: can we freeze auto-apply for previews touching the fallback route tag? we don't want to push credits live.
sylvie: yes. quick mitigation: set quota-hedging back to strict and flip rollout gate to 0%. also add a temporary consumer-side filter to ignore replayed 'session_credit_reemit' events for 10m.
otto: flipped gate at 08:05 and reverted hedging at 08:06. will push a consumer filter patch canary now.
metering-bot: consumer canary deploy 1766611149 succeeded at 08:07 UTC.
off: (typo)
noah: next: long-term fix is to centralize chargeable-event types in metering contracts: only 'final_session_commit' should mutate invoice counters. anything tagged 'fallback_emitted' must be telemetry-only unless reconciled.
sylvie: agree. need small schema update + migration plan. will draft RFC and a console flag to preview-only mode for suspected re-emits.
billing: once you have the tenant list we'll hold application and run a dedupe across the preview window. we prefer automated dedupe using (tenant,fingerprint,minute_bucket) for last 2h.
o tto: otto: running export now...
otto: exported affected_tenants.csv and attached to ENGPLAT-8700. creating follow-up tasks: dedupe job + RFC.
noah: thanks. adding dashboard card "preview-bias by quota-hedging" and an alert if >0.2% for 10m. closing loop in ENGPLAT-8700. :thumbsup:
